issues.description: User is being redirected to /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-8a instead of seeing the render result screen at /design/step-8a. The auth page is shown because the route /design/step-8a requires authentication and the user is not authenticated. The expected render result screen with AI-redesigned room image and before/after slider is not shown at all.
issues.element: Entire page — showing auth screen instead of step-8a render result screen
issues.root_cause: The middleware or route guard at apps/web/middleware.ts (or equivalent auth guard) is redirecting unauthenticated users to /auth. The page at apps/web/app/design/step-8a/page.tsx requires an authenticated session. The test user is not logged in, causing the redirect. The ?next param shows the intended destination. Additionally, there is a 400 error in console logs which may indicate a failed auth/session API call.
